description: Source code for a web-based database visualization interface, including HTML structure, CSS styling, and JavaScript logic for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for data table display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, including handling large objects and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
